description.value: Alfa Tea Concept is a bubble tea cafe located inside a unit at 8368 Capstan Way in Richmond, formerly operating under the name Macu. It offers indoor seating in a shopping complex setting, making it a convenient stop for a cool drink on a ride through Richmond's Capstan Village area.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 73m; rack at 97m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL points to Instagram, but the fetched content is only generic Instagram login/landing pages — no business-specific content was retrievable. All amenity assessments rely solely on OSM tags. OSM explicitly tags toilets=no, indoor_seating=yes, outdoor_seating=no, and cuisine=bubble_tea. The old_name=Macu tag indicates a recent rebrand.
concerns: Website URL is an Instagram profile which returned only generic login-wall content — no business-specific amenity information could be confirmed from the website.
OSM old_name=Macu indicates a recent business rebrand; the listing may still appear under the old name in some directories.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open bubble tea cafe with an active OSM record and Instagram presence; useful stop for cyclists seeking a cold drink in Richmond.
